DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

Your symptoms of double vision worsening with specific eye movements, combined with proximal muscle weakness that fatigues with activity and improves with rest, are classic for Myasthenia Gravis, whereas Tuberculosis does not present with this specific neuromuscular pattern.
